description: 中式英语（Chinglish）常见错误对照表，帮助识别和纠正不地道的英文表达

errors.note: ability 搭配 develop 更地道
避免 more and more + adj. 的中式表达

errors.native: an increasing/growing number of people / people in growing numbers
errors.note: 更正式的替换
考研作文中最常见的中式英语之一

errors.chinglish: with the rapid development of science and technology
errors.native: with the advent/advancement of technology / as technology advances
errors.note: 避免千篇一律的套话

errors.chinglish: play a more and more important role

errors.native: broaden one's horizons / widen one's perspective
errors.note: horizon 通常用复数 horizons

errors.native: get some rest / take a rest
exercise / work out / do physical exercise
errors.note: exercise 本身可作动词
learn 不搭配 knowledge
suggestion 搭配 make/offer

errors.native: fulfill/achieve one's dream / make one's dream come true
errors.note: realize 更常表示'意识到'

errors.native: the reason is that / this is because
errors.note: reason 后面用 that 不用 because
although 和 but 不能同时使用
because 和 so 不能同时使用
solve 多用于数学题或简单问题
need 通常用复数 needs

errors.native: make a contribution to / contribute to
errors.note: 注意冠词

errors.chinglish: protect the environment from being polluted
errors.note: from being polluted 过于累赘

errors.native: be concerned about / concern oneself with
errors.note: concern 作动词时是及物动词

errors.native: emphasize / place emphasis on / lay stress on
errors.note: emphasize 是及物动词，不加 on
拼写错误 + 搭配
nowadays/today 是副词，不加 in
worth 前不能用 very 修饰
appreciate 不搭配 very
economy是名词，economic是形容词
technology是名词
形容词和副词混淆

errors.native: I don't think we should ... / I don't believe that ...
errors.note: 英语中否定习惯前移到主句
图表不会'告诉'人，用 show 更准确

errors.native: 直接展开正反论述，避免使用此陈词滥调
errors.note: 此表达已被过度使用，阅卷老师反感
as we all know 过于口语化和笼统

errors.native: In conclusion, / To sum up, / All in all,
errors.note: in a word 不够正式

error_pairs.category: 过度使用类（考研作文高频套话）

errors.better: As ... advances/evolves / In the era of ...
errors.note: 最常见的中式开头

errors.better: 直接进入主题，或用 It is widely acknowledged that ...
Finally, / What is also noteworthy is that ...
errors.note: 已被过度使用

errors.better: While ... has its advantages, it also brings challenges.
errors.note: 最被阅卷老师反感的表达之一

errors.better: ... is of paramount/vital importance. / ... is essential.
errors.note: 适量使用可以，但不要每篇都用
